chunks: From him, from Ibrahim ibn Hashim, from al-Nawfali, from al-Sakuni, from Ja'far, from his father, from his forefathers, from Ali (peace be upon him), who said:
The Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family) said: "Swear by God falsely, and save your brother from death."
ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to swear a false oath by God to save a life?
ai.summary: This hadith from the *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* elucidates the principle of *al-yamin al-fudhuliyyah*, where a false oath is not only permissible but recommended to save a Muslim from death, prioritizing the preservation of life (*hifz al-nafs*) over the literal truth. In Shia jurisprudence, this is often contextualized within *tawqiyyah* (sealing with a seal) or *kashf* (revelation), where the oath serves as a protective mechanism rather than a deceptive lie, reflecting the pragmatic application of *fiqh al-awz'* (jurisprudence of circumstances).
